These lossless 64×64 crops come from the base and outfit sheets supplied for
the outfit repair bug report. The four columns are original frames 1, 4, 5,
and 6: idle, side idle, raised sleeve, and two raised sleeves.

The regression checks cover the reported neck gaps and sleeve pixels that
were previously replaced by bare forearms. These inputs are not golden
output images: palette/outline improvements can change the output while
the clothing coverage and exposed-skin requirements remain stable.
